rule_text.name: 702.302a
rule_text.rule: Retinue is a triggered ability, and a designation given to a group of permanents, which usually are tokens created by a retinue ability.

rule_text.name: 702.302b
rule_text.rule: "Retinue — [list of P/Ts]" means "When this permanent enters, for each listed P/T, create a red Army creature token with that P/T. Put each token created this way in this permanent's retinue." This list may include entries in the form "X [P/T]". In that case, X tokens are created instead of just one.

rule_text.name: 702.302c
rule_text.rule: As a player declares attacks, if a creature in a retinue or a creature with a retinue attacks, all creatures in that retinue also attack this combat if able. They may attack other players or permanents.

rule_text.name: 702.302d
rule_text.rule: As a player declares blocks, if a creature in a retinue or a creature with a retinue block, all creatures in that retinue also block this combat if able. They may block other creatures.

rule_text.name: 702.302e
rule_text.rule: A permanent can't have more than one retinue. If more permanents are added at a later time, they will be added to the previous retinue, and not a new one.

rule_text.name: 702.302f
rule_text.rule: A permanent can't be in more than one retinue. If it is put into one, it is removed from any retinue it was already in. If it is put into multiple simultaneously, its controller chooses one.

rule_text.name: 702.302g
rule_text.rule: If a permanent would be put into the retinue of a permanent that is itself in a retinue, they are instead put into the same retinue as that permanent.

rule_text.name: 702.302h
rule_text.rule: A retinue will continue to exist even if the permanent that it belongs to is no longer on the battlefield. Certain effects may also create a retinue that belongs to no permanent.

rule_text.name: 702.302i
rule_text.rule: A permanent can't be put into its own retinue.

rule_text.name: 702.302a
rule_text.rule: Retinue is a triggered ability, and a designation given to a group of permanents, which usually are tokens created by a retinue ability.

rule_text.name: 702.302b
rule_text.rule: "Retinue — [list of P/Ts]" means "When this permanent enters, for each listed P/T, create a red Army creature token with that P/T. Put each token created this way in this permanent's retinue." This list may include entries in the form "X [P/T]". In that case, X tokens are created instead of just one.

rule_text.name: 702.302c
rule_text.rule: As a player declares attacks, if a creature in a retinue or a creature with a retinue attacks, all creatures in that retinue also attack this combat if able. They may attack other players or permanents.

rule_text.name: 702.302d
rule_text.rule: As a player declares blocks, if a creature in a retinue or a creature with a retinue block, all creatures in that retinue also block this combat if able. They may block other creatures.

rule_text.name: 702.302e
rule_text.rule: A permanent can't have more than one retinue. If more permanents are added at a later time, they will be added to the previous retinue, and not a new one.

rule_text.name: 702.302f
rule_text.rule: A permanent can't be in more than one retinue. If it is put into one, it is removed from any retinue it was already in. If it is put into multiple simultaneously, its controller chooses one.

rule_text.name: 702.302g
rule_text.rule: If a permanent would be put into the retinue of a permanent that is itself in a retinue, they are instead put into the same retinue as that permanent.

rule_text.name: 702.302h
rule_text.rule: A retinue will continue to exist even if the permanent that it belongs to is no longer on the battlefield. Certain effects may also create a retinue that belongs to no permanent.

rule_text.name: 702.302i
rule_text.rule: A permanent can't be put into its own retinue.
